Description



The indoor swimming pool at Waterfront Leisure Centre is an excellent sized pool and large enough to exercise in. Roped off areas, classes and lessons are available but we recommend you contact the facility to check times, prices and availability. Swimming in London is not only an excellent way to stay fit and healthy, it’s also an excellent way to exercise whilst staying out of the cold weather. Swimming equipment such as goggles, swimming hats and costumes are sometimes available to buy at the facility but we recommend calling ahead to check this. Waterfront Leisure Centre provides one of the best swimming pools in London so make sure you pay it a visit.

Those driving are able to park free of charge at the facility. There are limited spaces available with weekends being particularly popular. The best parking availability is during the day and before 5pm.

There are smart and spacious changing rooms available for customers, with well-maintained facilities. This means customers can come straight from work or head out straight after.

The venue is situated near Woolwich Arsenal (DLR) station. From there it is a short walk to the facility which works out well for a gentle warm down after your booking.
